title: ECL Model Validation Document (MVD)
subtitle: Independent validation aligned to the RBI (Commercial Banks – Asset Classification, Provisioning and Income Recognition) Directions, 2026 – Chapter III (ECL-based Provisioning); effective 1 April 2027
howto: Pre-filled text is written so you can keep and adapt it rather than rewrite it. Replace everything in [square brackets]; pick one option where the bracket lists several separated by “/”. Thresholds marked illustrative must be replaced by the values in the approved model risk policy. Rate every test with the scale in the Rating Scales appendix. Delete each Section goal box and italic note before issuing the report. Where a section does not apply, write “Not applicable” with a one-line reason instead of deleting it.
